features.name: User registration
features.acceptance: Register same email with mixed case concurrently; exactly one account, no password in result, generic duplicate response.

features.name: Passwordless authentication
features.acceptance: Consume expired, replayed, wrong-tenant and wrong-purpose challenges; only one valid session.

features.name: Email verification
features.acceptance: Verify email twice and with a reset token; no unintended account verification.

features.name: Password reset
features.acceptance: Race two reset attempts; old credentials and sessions no longer work; prevent enumeration.

features.name: Login and logout
features.acceptance: Login with wrong password, locked account and MFA; logout revokes session on every replica.

features.name: Session management
features.acceptance: Expired/revoked session rejected on every replica; no other user's session listed.

features.name: JWT validation
features.implementation: Kingsman realm verifier or explicit external adapter
features.acceptance: Reject wrong issuer/audience, unsigned, expired, rotated and tenant-mismatched tokens.

features.name: API key lifecycle
features.acceptance: Plain key returned once; expired/revoked keys cannot authenticate; cross-tenant listing denied.

features.name: MFA and step-up auth
features.acceptance: Replay same TOTP concurrently; reject unenrolled/revoked factor and stale step-up.

features.name: SSO and SAML
features.acceptance: Validate signed assertion and relay state; reject replay, wrong issuer, wrong tenant and stale metadata.

features.name: OAuth2 and OIDC
features.acceptance: Exercise PKCE/state/nonce and refresh rotation; reject mismatched issuer and token reuse.

features.name: Social login
features.acceptance: Two identities with same unverified email cannot link; unlink preserves account recovery.

features.name: Device trust
features.acceptance: Unattested device remains pending; copied device ID fails trust decision.

features.name: Service accounts
features.acceptance: Revoke service credential; verify old token cannot access tenant or broader scope.

features.name: Role-based authorization
features.acceptance: Non-admin cannot grant wildcard or elevate own role; role changes affect current sessions.

features.name: Attribute-based authorization
features.acceptance: Missing/stale attributes deny; policy update invalidates old decision; cross-tenant ABAC denied.

features.name: Permission policies
features.acceptance: Conflicting allow/deny and malformed policies evaluated deterministically; default deny.

features.name: Account lockout
features.acceptance: Concurrent failed attempts enforce threshold; legitimate unlock does not reset unrelated accounts.

features.name: Tenant provisioning
features.acceptance: Crash between DB and provider steps; retry uses same tenant and no orphan infrastructure.

features.name: Tenant identification
features.acceptance: Spoofed tenant header, unknown host and stale membership never change context.

features.name: Tenant isolation
features.acceptance: Two tenant sessions attempt same ID, join, export, and raw SQL; none leaks data.

features.name: Tenant context propagation
features.acceptance: Interleaved concurrent requests/jobs retain independent context and never reuse another tenant.

features.name: Tenant data residency
features.acceptance: Write/read/backup in permitted region only; fail closed for unavailable region.

features.name: Tenant offboarding
features.acceptance: Retry every checkpoint after crash; hold prevents purge; no new jobs or sessions after freeze.
features.localEvidence: Offboarding regression and direct freeze integration

features.name: Organizations
features.acceptance: Create duplicate org and delete with active memberships; block cross-tenant access and cascade only explicitly.

features.name: Workspaces
features.acceptance: Workspace moved or deleted while active project exists; enforce owner and membership invariants.

features.name: Projects
features.acceptance: Create project under unauthorized workspace; update immutable fields and duplicate names denied.
features.localEvidence: Direct resource regression across two SDK instances

features.name: Teams
features.acceptance: Remove team with assigned permissions; stale authorization no longer grants access.

features.name: Membership management
features.acceptance: Concurrent membership create deduplicates; removing last owner or escalating role rejected.

features.name: User invitations
features.acceptance: Wrong identity, expired and reused invitation rejected; concurrent accept one membership.

features.name: Organization switching
features.implementation: KingsmanMembership on existing SDK membership rows
features.acceptance: Switch to unrelated org denied; old tenant token cannot read new tenant data.

features.name: Custom roles
features.acceptance: Unprivileged actor cannot create role with broader scopes; deletion of in-use role controlled.

features.name: Impersonation controls
features.acceptance: Impersonation cannot mutate billing or impersonate nested users; stop invalidates token.

features.name: Plans and tiers

features.name: Subscriptions

features.name: Subscription lifecycle

features.name: Usage metering

features.name: Quotas

backlog.finding: Direct resources and durable job admission lacked a transaction-scoped tenant freeze check.
backlog.remediation: Apply the same tenant lifecycle policy inside resource, job and outbox transactions.
backlog.acceptance: Two SDK instances with independent pools reject writes and claims for an offboarding tenant, preserve pending work, and resume after reactivation. Repeat in staging.

backlog.finding: ResourceService.list reads a whole collection before applying filters, authorization and pagination.
backlog.remediation: Design bounded pagination that preserves row authorization and documented sort and offset behavior.
backlog.acceptance: Bound reads across a representative tenant and verify stable order, filtering and pagination under concurrent writes.

backlog.finding: The consuming application authorization and its restricted database role have no staging signoff.
backlog.remediation: Review trusted actor context, tenant isolation, per-object policies and runtime role grants in the actual consuming app.
backlog.acceptance: Authorization matrix passes through public application entry points for two tenants and multiple roles, with build-bound application reviewer signoff.

backlog.finding: Durable OIDC, session revocation, signing rotation and account migration lack approved staging evidence.
backlog.remediation: Select and document the supported account store, provision approved password and signing providers, and rehearse upgrades and rollback.
backlog.acceptance: Conformance profile, revocation and rotation succeed across replicas. If credentials migrate, verify data, permissions and rollback with approved fixtures.

backlog.finding: The actual Harbor-to-application identity boundary, replica-shared limits and recovery remain unverified.
backlog.remediation: Use authenticated upstream transport and durable state in the reference topology. Review which identity headers the application accepts.
backlog.acceptance: Approved reference ingress verifies trusted identity, non-acceptance of unexpected identity, replica-wide controls, rotation and recovery.

backlog.finding: Provider delivery can succeed before a worker records completion. Worker delivery remains at least once.
backlog.remediation: Require documented idempotency or reconciliation contracts for every supported handler with an external side effect.
backlog.acceptance: Restart a worker between delivery and acknowledgement in staging. Confirm replay converges without duplicated business effects and failed work is observable.

backlog.finding: No approved production-equivalent staging topology, workload, alert routes or SLO decisions were provided.
backlog.remediation: Provision multiple replicas and two isolated tenants in approved staging. Set workload, safety limits, latency and error budgets before load.
backlog.acceptance: Run upgrades, dependency outage, load and soak against approved targets. Record latency, throughput, resource use, alert delivery and rollback.

backlog.finding: Disposable logical restore is verified. Deployment backups, point-in-time recovery, roles and recovery objectives remain open.
backlog.remediation: Exercise backup and recovery in a separate staging failure domain. Document restore order and permission recovery.
backlog.acceptance: Verify business invariants, runtime role isolation and the agreed recovery time and data loss targets after restoration.

backlog.finding: Local scan and dependency audit are available. Independent review and disposition of moderate advisories remain open.
backlog.remediation: Record dependency, image and source review and obtain independent signoff for the actual deployment.
backlog.acceptance: Zero unresolved critical or high findings and documented residual-risk acceptance bound to the exact candidate.

backlog.finding: Published install and entry-point smoke tests pass. Full supported consumer and upgrade matrices have gaps.
backlog.remediation: Test the documented runtime, module and peer combinations against release tarballs. Add regressions for any incompatibility.
backlog.acceptance: Required interfaces resolve in clean consumers with recorded versions and the previous supported version upgrades successfully.

backlog.finding: Authoritative Murphi redistribution evidence and native device and accessibility signoff are open.
backlog.remediation: Confirm rights and retain authoritative notices. Run approved device and browser accessibility checks for the supported UI profile.
backlog.acceptance: Signed rights record and test results for supported web and native platforms.

backlog.finding: Local and CI checks exist. Full supported quality profiles lack staging deployment evidence.
backlog.remediation: Run the quality CLI against approved staging and retain reports, budgets and required engine output.
backlog.acceptance: Configured suites report accurate pass, fail and skip outcomes. Required runs meet approved budgets and produce artifacts.

backlog.finding: AWS and Cashfree and other external integrations are outside the first core deployment milestone.
backlog.remediation: Define sandbox targets and a provider-specific rollout when support expands.
backlog.acceptance: Verify permitted success, failure, retry, reconciliation and isolation cases with approved accounts and scoped permissions.
